name: Gaziantep_SW.txt
text:
SWITCH#sh run
!
logging console 6
logging monitor 6
logging trap 6
!
spanning-tree mode mstp
telnet-server enable
ssh-server enable
web-server enable http
spanning-tree enable
!
vlan database
 vlan 301  name SWTCH state enable
 vlan 302  name VERO_DKKS state enable
 vlan 303  name KKC state enable
 vlan 304  name KAMERA state enable
 vlan 305  name VMS state enable
 vlan 306  name UPS state enable
 vlan 307  name BLUESS state enable
!
spanning-tree mst configuration
!
interface gigabitEthernet0/1
 description KAVSAK
 no spanning-tree enable
 switchport access vlan 303
!
interface gigabitEthernet0/2
 description KAVSAK
 no spanning-tree enable
 switchport access vlan 303
!
interface gigabitEthernet0/3
 description KAMERA
 no spanning-tree enable
 switchport access vlan 304
!
interface gigabitEthernet0/4
 description KAMERA
 speed 10
 duplex full
 flowcontrol on
 no poe enable
 no spanning-tree enable
 switchport access vlan 304
!
interface gigabitEthernet0/5
 description VMS
 speed 10
 duplex full
 no spanning-tree enable
 switchport access vlan 305
!
interface gigabitEthernet0/6
 description UPS
 speed 10
 no spanning-tree enable
 switchport access vlan 306
!
interface gigabitEthernet0/7
 description BLUESS
 no spanning-tree enable
 switchport access vlan 307
!
interface gigabitEthernet0/8
 no spanning-tree enable
!
interface gigabitEthernet0/9
 description VERO_DKKS
 no spanning-tree enable
 switchport access vlan 302
!
interface gigabitEthernet0/10
 description KAVSAK
 no spanning-tree enable
 switchport access vlan 303
!
interface gigabitEthernet0/11
 description KAVSAK
 no spanning-tree enable
 switchport access vlan 303
!
interface gigabitEthernet0/12
 description KAMERA
 no spanning-tree enable
 switchport access vlan 304
!
interface gigabitEthernet0/13
 description KAMERA
 no spanning-tree enable
 switchport access vlan 304
!
interface gigabitEthernet0/14
 description VMS
 no spanning-tree enable
 switchport access vlan 305
!
interface gigabitEthernet0/15
 description BLUESİS
 speed 10
 duplex full
 no spanning-tree enable
 switchport access vlan 307
!
interface gigabitEthernet0/16
 description BLUESS
 speed 10
 no spanning-tree enable
 switchport access vlan 307
!
interface gigabitEthernet0/17
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 1,301-307
!
interface gigabitEthernet0/18
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 1,301-307
!
interface vlan1
 ip address 20.0.1.63/24
!
interface vlan301
 ip address 20.30.1.63/24
!
ip route 0.0.0.0/0 20.30.1.254
!
line con 0
line vty 0 7
!
end

SWITCH#
